exposure: Monochorionic diamniotic (MCDA) twins with large intertwin hemoglobin difference
Large intertwin hemoglobin difference at birth (>8.0 g/dL)
large intertwin hemoglobin (Hb) difference at birth
outcome: Need for blood transfusion or partial-exchange transfusion
cohort: 432 monochorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies delivered at Osaka Medical Center and Research Institute for Maternal and Child Health between 2003 and 2012, excluding pregnancy terminations, acardiac twins, or intrauterine deaths
finding: A large intertwin hemoglobin difference at birth was observed in a small percentage of MCDA twins, with a significant portion requiring treatment for hematological abnormalities, indicating the need for close monitoring and management in this subgroup.
mod_finding: All MCDA twins with a large intertwin hemoglobin difference were delivered by Cesarean section, but this did not prevent the occurrence of AFFH.
gest_age: Median gestational age at birth of 34 weeks (range, 23-38 weeks)
